actual: Task qe_20260929_200405_d638 has Loops 1-3 with label_horizon=60 and Loops 4-6 with label_horizon=20. The QE loop config/readback correctly reports 20 for Loops 4-6, but qe_archive run and quality readback persist label_horizon=60 for those runs, making warehouse horizon grouping materially incorrect. Fix archive ingestion to use the authoritative per-loop config horizon, preserve fail-closed behavior, add mixed-horizon regression coverage, and do not rerun experiments or mutate historical production rows without separate authorization.

events.note: QEArchiveSourceAssembler only inspected runtime_flags.label_horizon before falling back to the task row, so modern mixed-horizon loops whose authoritative value is stored at config_json.label_horizon/model_params.label_horizon inherited the first task horizon.

The focused mixed-horizon regression failed with archived horizon 60 before the fix and passed with horizon 20 after per-loop authority resolution; legacy runtime_flags and task-only fallback remain covered, and conflicting loop fields fail closed.

expected: Archive ingestion must persist the authoritative horizon of each Loop, tolerate an intentionally different task-level horizon in a mixed-horizon task, retain legacy task fallback only when the Loop contains no horizon, and fail closed when explicit per-Loop horizon fields conflict.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
